title: b7z9.37.1.2(c): wire root-sig verification into lichen-node DIO receive path (L679)
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37.1.2. FINAL integration slice: in rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs DIO handling, when a DIO carries OPT_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE (0x17, lichen_rpl::message::RootDioSignature): decode via DecodedRootSig::from_cose_sign1, then DecodedRootSig::verify(pubkey, now, DioFields{from DIO header}, &mut self.root_seqs_mut()) consuming RootSeqCache; on validation failure reject the DIO with the RootSigError mapped to the receive error. OPEN DESIGN QUESTIONS to resolve before coding: (1) root pubkey acquisition — TOFU pin per (dodag_id,instance) on first verified DIO vs provisioned trust store (spec/06 8.10.1 receiver steps; check what the spec says about how receivers learn the root key); (2) L679: nodes MUST NOT reject DIOs solely due to missing root-signature validation capability — no-capability stacks (and DIOs without the option) process DIOs normally; (3) expiry clock source at the receive site (routing_now_ms is monotonic ms; expiry is unix seconds — needs the node's wall-clock seam). On landing: remove the interim #[cfg_attr(not(test), expect(dead_code))] on RplStack::root_seqs_mut.
